source_message.text:
To begin, Claude is requesting the following:
Token sheet — colors (hex, with bg/text/border/accent usage), type scale (family/weight/size/line-height/tracking per style), spacing scale, radii + border widths.
Font files — the .woff2 files, along with the exact family names and the weights that are actually in use.
Confirmed max content width — a single number so the precise container cap can be set.

token_sheet_contents: colors in hex with background, text, border, and accent usage
type scale with family, weight, size, line height, and tracking per style
